# LM3 off-the-shelf and RFQ candidate register

<!-- Generated by tools/automation/buildable-trainset.sh; do not hand-edit. -->

Freeze real catalogue candidates and vehicle-specific RFQ baselines for every bought-in LM3 product row.

**Release boundary:** A catalogue candidate proves that a relevant product exists; it does not prove LM3 fit, safety acceptance, availability, price, or authority approval. Exact order codes and supplier-controlled drawings remain mandatory before purchase or release.

Manufacturer sources checked on **2026-08-31**.

A complete system such as a door, bogie, HVAC unit or gangway is vehicle-specific even when its supplier uses a standard platform. Exact catalogue components are therefore separated from RFQ baselines and partial interface kits.

| Bought-in LM3 rows with a sourcing candidate | 56 / 56 |
| Rows containing at least one exact catalogue component | 10 |

## Integration and closure actions

### `OSR-COTS-DOOR-IFE` — Knorr-Bremse IFE IFE modular sliding-plug entrance system

- Source class: `vehicle-specific-rfq`
- Local manufacture: Buy the first cassette and controller; manufacture portal, threshold, carrier, harness and service parts locally to the released interface.
- Before freeze:
  - freeze clear aperture, stroke, mass and four mounting datums
  - obtain EN 14752 evidence and emergency-release/cycle data
  - freeze keyed power, network and interlock interfaces

### `OSR-COTS-GLASS-AGC` — AGC Automotive rail glazing with framing system

- Source class: `vehicle-specific-rfq`
- Local manufacture: Retain the pressure-frame and dry-seal replacement concept; qualify regional laminators against the released cassette drawing.
- Before freeze:
  - freeze laminate stack, optical zones and curvature
  - freeze heated end-glass voltage and power
  - obtain impact, fire, weather and bond-system evidence

### `OSR-COTS-FINISH-3M-180MC` — 3M Controltac Graphic Film with Comply Adhesive 180mC family

- Source class: `catalogue-family-with-rail-application-guidance`
- Local manufacture: Plot, print, label and apply pre-cut one-metre-bay kits locally; accept another supplier only through complete-system equivalence rather than nominal film thickness.
- Before freeze:
  - select film colour/print, ink, overlaminate and edge system together
  - obtain project fire and hot-climate exposure evidence
  - run adhesion, wash, weather, repair and removal trials on the actual LM3 base finish

### `OSR-COTS-COOLROOF-PURDUE-CACO3` — Purdue University research team (reference only) 2020 CaCO3-acrylic particle-matrix paint formulation

- Source class: `research-formulation-not-orderable`
- Local manufacture: Local coupon preparation is encouraged, but fleet application remains prohibited until an orderable controlled formulation and signed rail qualification pack exist.
- Before freeze:
  - identify a controlled commercial binder/pigment/additive formulation
  - obtain rail fire, chemical and application evidence
  - pass GFRP adhesion/flexibility plus UV, abrasion, wash and soiling ageing
  - measure new/aged optical performance and complete a one-car thermal/maintenance trial

### `OSR-COTS-GLAZING-SIKA268` — Sika Sikaflex-268 PowerCure, 600 ml

- Local manufacture: Use locally applied standard cartridges with supplier-approved pretreatment; retain a mechanical pressure frame so glass replacement is not adhesive-only.

  - bondline calculation and physical coupon validation
  - lot and shelf-life control
